annotations.title: Prepare an operation on the vault

description: Build the unsigned transactions for any operation on the GBLIN vault, in the order to send them. Actions: mint_with_eth (amount in ETH), mint_with_weth (amount in WETH), mint_with_usdc (amount in USDC, through the Zap), redeem_in_kind (amount in shares; pro rata basket tokens, no fee, no price feed), exit_to_eth (amount in shares, through the Zap, all or nothing), exit_to_usdc (amount = the USDC you need), bid (trade with the rebalancing auction; row optional, the largest gap by default). Every output bound is non-zero and every step through the vault or the Zap carries its gas limit. Nothing is signed or sent: simulate the steps with preview_steps, then send them from the wallet.

amount.description: Decimal amount. Unit depends on the action (see the description). Not used by bid.

row.description: bid only: the basket row to bid on. Default: the row with the largest gap.

wallet_address.description: The wallet that will sign and receive.

name: prepare_action

expected.description: What the operation should deliver, with the minimums applied.

items.description: One transaction to send, in order: target, calldata, value in wei, and gas when the step needs an explicit limit. The same call is repeated as to, data and chainId (8453) for wallet batch APIs such as send_calls.
